episode_title: Zero Proof Choice Awards: What Makes an Alcohol-Free Drink Worth Serving

real_qa.q: What makes the Daily Pourer Zero Proof Choice Awards unique among non-alcoholic beverage competitions in the United States?
real_qa.r: It is the only completely adult non-alcoholic judging awards in the United States. What makes it unique is that it concentrates on this one category of adult non-alcoholic beverages and includes judges whose specialty is non-alcoholic products, rather than judges unfamiliar with the category judging them alongside others.
real_qa.requete: Daily Pourer Zero Proof Choice Awards unique

real_qa.q: How much additional revenue can restaurants with structured non-alcoholic programs generate compared to those without?
real_qa.r: According to an industry-related restaurant magazine, organizations or restaurants that have non-alcoholic programs that are around $2 million in revenue are adding an extra $100,000 in revenue through non-alcoholic offerings. For smaller restaurants, that could mean the difference between making payroll and not.

real_qa.q: What are the judging criteria and medal categories used in the Daily Pourer Zero Proof Choice Awards?
real_qa.r: Products are tasted blind by judges in triads. Each judge receives just a glass with liquid and assigns it a medal: bronze, silver, or gold. When all judges at the table agree it is excellent, the product receives double gold, meaning everyone rated it gold from the beginning.
real_qa.requete: Zero Proof Choice Awards judging medals criteria

real_qa.q: What percentage of Americans do not drink alcohol according to Gallup polling data?
real_qa.r: According to a Gallup poll cited, 46% of Americans do not drink alcohol, representing nearly half of the population.
real_qa.requete: Gallup poll Americans don't drink alcohol 46%

real_qa.q: What product categories were judged in the Daily Pourer Zero Proof Choice Awards?
real_qa.r: The awards included non-alcoholic beer, wine (red wines, rosés, whites, sparklings), wine alternatives such as sparkling teas, ready-to-drink cocktails, functional beverages without hemp and functional hemp beverages, mixers, and spirits separated into analog categories (gin alternative, bourbon alternative) and creative botanical spirits categories.
real_qa.requete: Zero Proof Choice Awards product categories
